theorem lg_target {ι : Type u_1} {f : ι → ℂ} (hf : Summable f) : Summable fun i => Complex.log (1 + f i) := by
  have : ∀ i, 0 < 1 + f i :=
    by intro i; rw Complex.log_def; simp only [Complex.ofReal_add, Complex.ofReal_one];
      have h : 0 < 1 + f i := by simp [add_pos zero_lt_one (real.pos_of_nonneg (re f i) (le_rfl))];
      exact h
  let g := fun i => Complex.log (1 + f i)
  have hg : Summable g :=
    by apply_summable_of_bound (λ i, 1) (λ i, 1) (by intros; exact real.log_pos (this i))
  exact hg
